events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her unmistakable voice and attitude have shaped rock for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his swagger is still unmatched. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine All The People
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The comedic genius, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, his comedy is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles release 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965 in the UK.

angles.name: A Fab Four Classic
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'! Released in '65, it marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this iconic album?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of The Beatles icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On this poignant day, we remember John Lennon, who left us far too soon in 1980. His legacy of peace and music lives on.
